title: Survival Island
description: Wash up on a blocky island: chop trees, mine stone, iron and glowing crystals, craft tools and build a shelter before night falls and the monsters come out. Play alone or with friends on the same island.
controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, F or click to gather and use, C to craft, 1-9 to pick items, E to eat, R to rotate builds, X to remove your builds
